first_causal_log: Xvfb: Cannot write display number to fd4; Ottrin subsequently could not connect to X
runner_defect: The single read closed the readiness pipe without requiring the complete newline-terminated display number. A partial read could close it before Xvfb finished writing.
fix: Read bounded chunks until newline under a deadline, reject EOF/invalid display/dead server, then close the pipe
subsequent_checks: Same candidate passes Dark100 and Light150 real GUI cleanup/menu checks, normal exit and private teardown
